notes.title: Raining Blood + Heavy.Future
notes.content:
🎸 Raining Blood + Heavy.Future

Raining Blood is teaming up with Heavy.Future, a music label dedicated to producing and promoting independent heavy metal. Their main project is led by the band and influencer ocaradometal.

We’re bringing 5 brand-new tracks from them into the game! Now, every boss fight has its own unique soundtrack to make battles even more epic.

The new songs added are:

Seafarer - Dandy Cadet 

Autoconhecimento – ocaradometal

Crise Existencial – ocaradometal

In the Sand We Step – Psycho Decadence

Sunrise – Psycho Decadence

Guerreiros MIDI – ocaradometal

notes.title: Raining Blood 1.0 is out!
notes.content:
Patch 1.0 — Blood Called for Change
It’s time to dive back into hell. This is the biggest update we’ve ever made — a true rebirth for Raining Blood. From fully reworked systems to new bosses, environments, weapons, and an even deeper story, this update takes the war against demons to the next level. Azaus is back. Bloodier, more strategic, and with much more to lose.
[hr][/hr]The New Rune System
The old upgrade system has been buried. In its place, Runes rise — artifacts that grant devastating abilities, with effects that go far beyond simple stat boosts.

Some Runes alter weapon behavior, firing multiple projectiles or summoning spinning blades and orbiting weapons that protect and slice through enemies. Others grant survival benefits — life regeneration, temporary invulnerability when hit, and even a chance to ignore damage altogether.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/7a79a5841905540f894a2ecbf45f640ef22c18c3.gif"]

There are also those focused on pure destruction: critical damage boosts, instant kill chances, and auto-executions. For efficiency lovers, some Runes expand magazines, save ammo, or instantly reload your equipped weapon.

The most exciting part? Runes interact with each other. When combined correctly, simple bonuses can transform into absurdly powerful effects.
[hr][/hr]

Blood Ritual: New Unlock System
To unlock Runes, you must pay the price: complete a ritual by killing a specific number of enemies. Once completed, you may choose one of three random Rune variations — and that choice will be locked until the end of the current station.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/e11bdd90f63e1ced4117a299246e660ed3b5a310.png"]

This decision is final. But the right combinations of Rune variants can lead to divine results.

Yes, Runes can still be purchased multiple times... up to a certain limit. The choice is yours — and so is the risk.
[hr][/hr]


Paths of Power
Each Rune belongs to one of the Paths: Focus, Power, Time, Luck, and Balance.

Stacking Runes from the same Path grants passive buffs. For example, having two Luck Runes increases item drop chance by 10%. The more you specialize in a Path, the stronger — and more predictable — it becomes.
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/82728174a6cc60fdd88d979063557df153ff357b.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/b067b400368a8cd5e2d948669e4df5db2be40e0c.png"][/carousel][hr][/hr]


New Weapons, Elemental Melee
Weapons have been reinforced — and now melee weapons are blessed (or cursed) with elemental powers. Get ready to slash, burn, freeze, and electrocute your enemies with stylish brutality.
[hr][/hr]


New Interface
The HUD has been redesigned from scratch. Cleaner, more visible, and more functional. You’ll also see a health bar floating above your character, making tense moments more readable.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/0103d0f13a05160fc7c9342138d144564333dd67.png"]
[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/f12a1a4113df9527c2cfc6bfd476b8a906a8dcb7.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/949a89040cba9f2bfb2760cf96b17551ded12f77.png"][/carousel]
The Rune and Weapon menus have also been revamped. Navigation is faster, visuals are clearer, and information is easier to access.
[hr][/hr]


 Skill Tree: 76 Reasons to Restart
We’ve introduced a full skill tree with 76 unique passive abilities. Now, every choice matters. Each new run defines a unique playstyle. No two matches will ever be the same.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/da3d8d317fa9c67bd3e6390494443f97abb366af.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/106ac1f6b36e089f053a43798a6b60ee0d5598a8.png"]
[hr][/hr]


 New Environments
This update brings four fully playable new maps — and a fifth one we dare not spoil...


The Void
The player’s new central hub. A safe space between battles to change characters, talk to NPCs, and plan your next move.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/06576b76285089e519e9188b76f1d3b03363f981.png"]


The Catacombs
Dark and damp hallways where even the shadows try to kill you.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/8445f6f4f4528f16cc2a003158c97d5f3d382356.png"]


HellChaotic. Fiery. Home to your worst nightmares.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/b3682f5bceb1e7aa9af967cdaec6ed46c9082aca.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/fb4f9e2d72f72a966ca99659f6cb3209e49a9cea.png"]


Stairway to Heaven
Redemption is made of steps. Many of them. None of them merciful.
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/d1169fa952fafdf857ada1b765c7f4e5aed75b74.png"][/carousel]



New Bosses
Each stage now ends with an exclusive — and unforgettable — boss.

The Psychopato: a gangster duck guarding Heaven's gate with an egg machine gun.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/4bcbcc14190e8fa27a6186fb0470c15f4245b275.png"]

Gael, the Betrayer: a fallen angel who now hunts exorcists.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/f40fe37aaea473a047268bcb307426fee73c1fe3.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/ee6ce128b9be8e6b702394f7a0d1181dd63a5168.gif"]

Hells Bells: demonic bells that guard the catacombs where Lucifer fell.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/7f41e8559ef60878f41c1481ab774925a8cb0172.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/eb247bb7301b2bbd15160abe9a3c9c173b522487.png"]

Gorfo: a grotesque demon who throws boulders and screams like the world is ending.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/38edd4f9a2c4e917c5274f00c468cb1746914d90.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/1efaa16eaeb35053dff26075ce034cc0662fd8ef.png"]

And there's... one more. But you'll have to find out for yourself.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/b7115a0be6316edde5f4301927bb006151e00e00.png"]
[hr][/hr]


Elemental Damage System
Combat is now deeper with a new interactive elemental damage system.

Some elements work better against certain types of enemies. Water extinguishes fire. Electricity is stronger against wet enemies. Ice freezes, fire burns, blunt damage stuns, cutting causes bleeding... and it all stacks in real time.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/b780283f20b058719059997d77a3d7f2f9b355dc.gif"]

Enemies with certain status effects have resistances and vulnerabilities. Using the wrong type might reduce damage. The right one might double it.



This chart shows how damage types interact with enemy types:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/adc568ad8e35e2f6e6778742a4dd4cccfb501570.png"]



Each type of damage inflicts a unique status effect:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/e53ba6f376239101715e6a165b27df293f25754d.png"]



Enemies already under a certain effect can still take extra damage or resist further hits. For example: a soaked enemy takes almost no fire damage. But hit them with ice? Massive bonus damage.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/2277bab5fa704bf6cee630d3b25ebf5159988886.png"]
[hr][/hr]


Tweaked Spawns and New Enemies
The spawn system has been completely rebalanced. Difficulty now scales with surgical precision, with special waves every multiple of 5 (5, 10, 15…), where elite enemies appear to test all you've learned.

We also added new enemy types:

Necromancers

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/d1eb8dcf3da862f8884958a650f80baa060a5976.gif"]

Skeleton Archers

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/d5cc013490335e7166653f30546c5c7992ae651d.gif"]

Bombers

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/621f9c7696fadae38c889dc88b2cc02ad987b5be.gif"]

Each has unique behavior and specific weaknesses.
[hr][/hr]


Safe Zones and NPCs
Between stages, players will now encounter safe zones to breathe, prepare, and interact with the world. For the first time, NPCs will talk to you — including that strange figure who appears every time you die... Who is he?

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/c2243b37bcd7eb2221d50584210599cd8caf25b0.png"]
[hr][/hr]


Steam Achievements
We launched 30 initial achievements, with many more on the way. Get ready to unlock bloody feats — and laugh at your many deaths.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/13c42b738460171df1cedebbc1135fedf33aa547.png"]
[hr][/hr]


A New Story Begins
Azaus, a member of the Sacred Exorcist Order, is sent to Hell to investigate a demonic invasion that threatens the balance between Heaven and Earth. After falling in battle, he is reborn in the Void and meets Mr. Crowley — a mysterious angel who revives him... but steals his powers. Now, wielding an artifact that absorbs enemy blood and turns it into strength, Azaus embarks on his final mission: uncover the truth behind Hell's collapse... and take revenge.
[hr][/hr]
Update the game. Die. Restart. Evolve.
Hell is new.
So are you.

 Raining Blood — Patch 1.0

notes.title: What Are We Working on for Version 1.0?
notes.content:
Hello, Demon Hunters!

It’s been a while since I’ve shared updates about the game’s development. I usually post more on Discord about what we’re working on, but for those who aren’t in the server: the game is still in development—and it’s getting better and better!

We’re preparing a MASSIVE update for next year. Bigger than anything we’ve ever done before. It will feature more enemies, elite enemies, boss fights, new environments, NPCs, a new damage system with elemental synergies, a revamped upgrade system, a skill tree, passive abilities for characters, and much more.

Here’s a sneak peek at what we’re working on:

New Enemies
There will be new enemies with unique behaviors. We're also reworking the enemies already in the game.

notes.title: Biggest Update to date! V 0.9 is here
notes.content:
Patch Notes - Version Beta 0.9

New Feature:
You can now revive using your Demon Horns.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/46fcdcbb8fdecf2a6966d04ac88dbd91bd81286b.png


Reworks & Improvements:

Physics Improvements:

Fireball enemy bodies are now pushed with the force of the last shot.
Large larva bodies now have physics.
Improved physics for enemy body impacts: they no longer bounce like footballs.
Improved explosion physics: damage increases the closer the target is to the epicenter, and pushes enemies based on their distance from the epicenter. The player needs to be very close to the explosion to take damage.

Cemetery Gates Rework:

Removed one of the purposeless gates.
Better weapons distributed in the initial area.

Weapon Improvements:

Buffed grenade launcher: more bullets and larger explosion radius.
Improvements to all explosive weapons.
Upgrades to most weapons.
Buff to Azau's dash.
Buff to Azau's knife.
Buff to Big Iron: more damage, faster bullets, greater knockback.
Buff to various other weapons.
Reworked bullet physics on enemies: bullets now push enemies according to shot speed.
Bullets push enemies farther.
Applied bullet physics to flying enemies: flyers now recoil from shots.

General Improvements:

Striker can now be upgraded at Caishen.
Damage numbers now appear with explosions.
Prices of doors and weapons shown in green when affordable. In red only when not.
Animation when earning more points.
Pop-up animation for hit indicators on enemies.
Floating text indicating the amount of points earned.
New players start the game with 10 Demon Horns.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed the bug causing OctoHead projectiles to move strangely when hit and when dying.
Fixed the bug with controller input when selecting the language on the first game launch.
More than 3 runes in the inventory no longer get cut off.

Gameplay Adjustments:

Easy mode temporarily removed.
Faster pacing: new hordes start more quickly.
Different types of enemies now spawn at the beginning of the game.
More points awarded per kill.
Rain effect during multiple waves of 5. OctoHead now spawns in waves 5, 10, and 15.
Renamed Extra Ammo Rune to Extended Mag for better clarity.

notes.title: Merry Christmas! Beta v 0.8.4 is now live!
notes.content:
Seasonal Touch: Christmas Decorations

Immerse yourself in the holiday season with the introduction of Christmas-themed decorations throughout the game environment.

Enhanced Power-Up Retrieval Mechanism
Power-ups now exhibit improved dynamics, gravitating towards the player for enhanced accessibility and engagement.

Optimized Power-Up Text
The textual display upon power-up acquisition has been refined for better clarity and informativeness. Additionally, a previously identified freezing issue upon collecting power-ups has been addressed.

Bug Resolution: Persistent Enemy Actions Post-Player Defeat
Rectified a critical bug where enemies continued to inflict and receive damage, as well as execute attacks after the player's character had been defeated. This bug also caused disruptive visual effects on the death screen.

Expanded Safe Zone Implementation
Implemented an enlarged safe zone around the player character to mitigate the occurrence of enemies spawning in close proximity, ensuring a more balanced gameplay experience.

Spawn Delay Adjustment
Enemies will now take a slightly longer duration before initiating their spawn, providing players with a brief respite

Camera Shake Refinement
Resolved instances of excessive camera shake during explosive events, ensuring a more controlled and visually comfortable gaming experience.

🚀 Easy mode 

🔧 Runes balancing

🐛 Bug fixes

🔧 More money: It's easier now to get blood points

🚀 Map: you can now see the whole level and the locations of important items pressing “M”

🔧 You can now destroy enemy projectiles with melee attacks.

🚀 Improved enemy AI: Faster enemy movement when they're far from the player.

🔧 UI adjustments for a smoother experience.

🐛  General bug fixes for enhanced gameplay.
